paper_metadata.title: INCREASED INTRACRANIAL HEMORRHAGE AMID ELEVATED INFLAMMATORY MARKERS IN THOSE WITH COVID-19 SUPPORTED WITH EXTRACORPOREAL MEMBRANE OXYGENATION

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: The study clearly defines the target population (COVID-19 ARDS requiring ECMO) and provides detailed inclusion criteria, recruitment periods, and baseline characteristics for two academic centers. The sample is representative of the specific clinical niche described.

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: While most ICH cases were confirmed by objective imaging (CT/MRI), one case was diagnosed clinically (fixed pupils), and the retrospective nature means imaging was likely symptom-driven rather than universal screening, potentially missing subclinical ICH.

items.reasoning: The outcome (ICH) is defined by imaging or clear clinical signs.

items.reasoning: Most outcomes were validated by imaging, but the inclusion of a purely clinical diagnosis introduces a small risk of misclassification.

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: The study identifies and measures key confounders (age, sex, comorbidities, ARDS severity). However, due to the small sample size (N=33), the authors could not perform multivariable adjustment to independently confirm the prognostic value of inflammatory markers while controlling for all other factors.
